description: card chat-S5 (PD337(d), user 2026-10-03 'S1'): ONE release of a blocking prior-art / review verdict, written by tools/protocol.py write_release (CLI: py tools/protocol.py release ...) into the review file's '## What was done with it' section as a `RELEASE {json}` line followed by the legacy `FIXED:` / `REFUTED:` line every existing reader (guard_cycle.released_slugs, stop_record) keeps reading. `slug` is checked AT WRITE TIME against the slugs the review itself issued (its PRIOR-ART: lines) and guard_cycle.PRIOR_ART_SLUGS; a FIXED path must exist and post-date the review (guard_cycle.review_time). 143-1 lost a launch to a FIXED line with a review slug that stop_record refused.
